text: THE DBIM HOME PAGE NOW MEETS THE DBIM 3.0 MANUAL'S TYPE, COLOUR AND LAYOUT RULES, AND THE CLOSED ACCESSIBILITY PANEL IS OUT OF THE TAB ORDER ON EVERY PAGE. The panel fix is estate-wide: it waited six seconds and gave up, so on /website a keyboard reached 17 hidden controls before the skip link. On the DBIM design, laptops (1280–1536) get the desktop type scale instead of the phone scale. Every size carries only a weight Table 3 or 4 allows, with the role's leading. The off-palette greys, black and ink fills are gone. Pointer hover shows on every clickable item. The footer and PM Quote sit on the page edge. On a phone the Department line leads the lock-up and the search row stays pinned. The cookie bar no longer hides the focused control. The PM portrait is the transparent cut-out. The social band reads In Social Media, and all-caps feed titles are shown in Title Case with the lnviting/lnterest typo repaired.
